# vMLX 1.6.68

## Checkpoint highlights

- Native JANGH loading with legacy JANGTQ v2 compatibility and exact codebook-fit reuse during startup.
- Faster SSD prefix-candidate hashing, corrected native Qwen checkpoint replay, and recovery from invalid longer GLM cache entries using a valid shorter prefix.
- Correct sampled MTP acceptance and fail-closed rollback; improved Responses tool/media history and native GLM reasoning-effort handling.
- Clearer loading/cache statistics, video metadata preservation, and elapsed time across tool continuations.

Expert-aligned Hadamard prefill, fused H32 rotation, bounded GLM media prefill and KDA substitution remain opt-in. This checkpoint does not claim sustained MTP throughput above autoregressive decoding across all quants. Isolated cache-lookup improvements do not imply universal decoding or TTFT gains.
